basic_info.description:
Gorgeous one-bedroom home in one of San Francisco's National Historic Landmark buildings is now up for love!

Originally a railroad warehouse built in 1852, 101 Harrison Street was converted to live/work lofts in 1996. Your future home is on the 3rd floor and highlights an exposed brick wall, part of the original building, in the living area.

It features an open layout giving you more than enough space for multiple entertainment and work areas. Huge windows flood this home with plenty of natural light and provide ventilation.

Open kitchen comes with color-matched appliances that complement the modern industrial design of the home. The spacious kitchen island includes a built-in electric range and oven for a minimalist look!

Down the hallway is a generously sized bedroom finished in carpet and a full bathroom with a shower over tub feature. This home also comes with in-unit laundry machines for easier chore completion at any time.

Your future home is perfectly located a block away from the waterfront and is minutes away from the Embarcadero, the Ferry Building, the Financial Center, the Caltrain, and Light Rail!

Welcome to a new kind of rental experience. Welcome to Belong. We are here to make sure you love your new home. 

To apply for this home and schedule tours, please visit our website! 

 CA DRE License #02082345

Utilities included in rent: water, gas, trash, sewage

Pet Deposit: $500
